meta.revisionNote: Revision 3 (Aug 16). 15 km at 6:28/km over ~378 m climbing, HR 146, +3bpm drift over 96 min. EF +14% since June, cadence 143->165. Goal pace revised 6:55 -> 6:20/km. Peak long run raised to 32 km. Hill repeats retained (dune terrain).

foundation.notes: 8 weeks of consistent training with zero missed weeks. Handling 4 runs/week comfortably.

currentForm.notes: 15 km at 6:28/km over ~378 m of climbing, mean HR 146, peak 157, only +3 bpm drift over 96 min. Even 5 km splits (6:24/6:35/6:24). Efficiency factor up 14% since June.

strengths.evidence: Only +3 bpm cardiac drift over 96 min on hilly terrain — exceptional aerobic control
Cadence improved 143 -> 165 spm, reducing impact load per step
Efficiency factor +14% in 8 weeks (same HR, 1:10/km faster)
Zero missed training weeks; knee has stayed symptom-free

limiters.evidence: Only 2 strength sessions logged since June — the main injury risk as volume climbs
Untested beyond 15 km; the 25–42 km range is entirely unknown territory
Long runs carry ~25 m/km of climbing — great training, but means flat-ground race pace is still unmeasured

constraints: Rolling dune terrain near the coast — hillier than the flat Valencia course

hr.notes: Observed max 183 in hard sessions. Zones validated against 8 weeks of data — easy runs sit correctly at 142–147.

pace.notes: Revised UP from 6:55/km after the 15 km at 6:28 with negligible drift. Final goal confirmed after the 26–28 km runs in October.

phases.name: Build
phases.focus: Tempo + MP work, long run to 26 km

workouts.name: Strength B — Core & Stability
workouts.description: Core + single-leg balance. Protects form when you fatigue late in long runs.
workouts.humanReadable:
Warm-up (5 min): cat-cow, bird-dog 2x8
Main (3 rounds, 45s rest):
  • Plank — 30–45s
  • Side plank — 20–30s each side
  • Dead bug — 8 each side
  • Single-leg deadlift — 8 each leg
  • Step-ups onto chair — 10 each leg
Cool-down (5 min): pigeon stretch, child's pose

workouts.name: Easy + 5 Strides — 45 min
workouts.description: Easy aerobic plus short pickups to hold leg speed and high cadence.
workouts.humanReadable:

Main: 20 min easy

Cool-down: 5 min easy

workouts.name: Easy Run — 35 min (optional 4th run)

workouts.name: 🏁 VALENCIA MARATHON 42.2 km
workouts.description: RACE DAY! See Race Strategy tab.
workouts.humanReadable: Goal 6:20/km (~4:27). First 10 km at 6:30 — deliberately held back. Settle into 6:20 from km 10. Walk aid stations to fuel cleanly. 30g carbs every 30 min from km 8. The training is in your legs.

pacing.strategy: Controlled negative split — hold back early, press late

firstHalf.notes: DELIBERATELY slower than goal. It will feel far too easy — that is exactly right.

secondHalf.notes: If you reach 32 km still strong, press to 6:10. Otherwise hold.

pacing.lastTenK: Whatever remains. Aim to pass people from km 32 on.
pacing.warnings: Your easy pace is now ~6:25, so 6:20 will feel deceptively comfortable at the start. The marathon punishes that feeling at km 32. Hold the leash for 10 km.

nutrition.preRace: Night before: pasta + lean protein, nothing new. 3 hr before: ~100g carbs (oatmeal, banana, honey, low fibre). Coffee 60 min before if usual.

during.schedule: Gel at km 8, then every 5 km (8/13/18/23/28/33/37). ~25g each. Walk aid stations to drink properly.
during.products: Only what you have practised in long runs.

nutrition.rule: Nothing new on race day. Lock the fuel protocol in from the 24 km run onward.

raceMorning.gear: Only what you have trained in. New shoes = blisters.

mentalCues: Km 1–10: 'Too easy. Good. That's the plan.'
Km 11–21: 'Rhythm. Drink. Fuel. Relax the shoulders.'
Km 22–32: 'Now the race starts. Quick feet, tall posture.'
Km 33–42: 'Everyone hurts now. The 32 km run is in my legs. One km at a time.'

postRace.immediate: Keep walking 10 min. Electrolytes. Eat within 30 min.
postRace.next72hrs: Light walking only. No running. Sleep.
postRace.return: First easy jog 5–7 days after. Two unstructured weeks before any structure.

coachingNotes: 📈 REVISION 3 (Aug 16): Your 15 km at 6:28/km with mean HR 146 and only +3 bpm drift over 96 minutes is a genuinely strong aerobic performance. Efficiency factor is up 14% since June at identical heart rate. Goal pace moves from 6:55 to 6:20/km (~4:27 finish).

🎯 The new goal is provisional. It is built on a 15 km effort — the 26 km and 28 km runs in October are what actually confirm it. If those go well, 6:10 is on the table. If they hurt, we move back toward 6:35. No ego either way.

👟 Cadence went 143 → 165 spm. That is a real, meaningful change: shorter stride, less impact per footfall, and very likely part of why the knee has stayed quiet. Keep it there — the strides sessions exist partly to maintain it.

💪 STRENGTH IS THE GAP. Two sessions logged since June. You are about to double your long run from 15 to 32 km. Single-leg and glute work is what keeps a quiet knee quiet under that load. Monday and Friday, 25–30 minutes. This is the one thing in the plan I would not negotiate on.

⛰️ Your runs carry real climbing — the 15 km had ~378 m of ascent (124 flights), the 12 km on Aug 2 had ~418 m. The Elevation Ascended field exports blank, but Flights Climbed captures it. Hill repeats stay in the plan. Valencia is pancake-flat, so your flat-ground pace is very likely 10–20 sec/km quicker than these numbers suggest — the 6:20 goal has margin.

🏃 Long runs are now the whole game: 16 → 18 → 20 → 22 → 24 → 26 → 28 → 30 → 32 km. Keep them at HR 138–150 (~6:40–7:05/km) — slower than your easy runs. Time on feet builds the durability that pace cannot.
😴 Recovery is your real limiter (work + a 1-year-old). The Wednesday run stays OPTIONAL. Three quality runs beat four tired ones, every time.
🥗 From the 24 km run onward, practise race fuelling exactly: 30g carbs every 30 min. Your gut needs training as much as your legs.

⌚ Duplicate 'Indoor Run' entries appeared alongside outdoor runs in July–early August (Watchletic recording without GPS). They stopped after Aug 4 — worth confirming your recording setup is clean so training load isn't double-counted.
🧪 Next checkpoint: after the 26 km run (week 8, early October). Export then and we will finalise race pace.
